answer_1.quote: We use the WMT'24 metrics shared task data ... covering three translation directions: English → German (EN‑DE), Japanese → Chinese (JA‑ZH) and English → Spanish (EN‑ES).
answer_1.outputs: MQM error spans with categories, severities and optional quality scores

answer_2.quote: We use system-level pairwise accuracy as our evaluation metric. Additionally, we measure the number of error spans per document and the character F1 score.

answer_3.quote: LLMs have demonstrated SOTA performance in evaluating short-form translations, when prompted to produce error spans with categories defined by MQM. We evaluate three proprietary LLMs ... as well as three open weight LLMs ... to assess translation quality.
